exercises.question: (4) numaralı boşluk için en uygun kelimeyi seçin.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘atmospheric’ (atmosferdeki): amaç havadaki karbondioksiti tehlikeli düzeyin altında tutmaktır. ‘aquatic’ (suya ait), ‘igneous’ (magmatik), ‘glacial’ (buzula ait) ve ‘cosmic’ (kozmik) iklim değişikliği bağlamında karbondioksiti nitelemez.

exercises.question: In a battery, chemical reagents react and electrons flow out of the negative electrode, known as the ----, where metal may slowly oxidize, and through an external circuit, which is how a battery, like a small generator, can power a device.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘anode’ (anot): bataryanın elektrotlarından biri. ‘piston’ (piston), ‘antenna’ (anten), ‘actuator’ (eyleyici) ve ‘thermostat’ (termostat) elektrot değildir.

exercises.text: Engineers hope that ___, the complete loss of electrical resistance in some materials at very low temperatures, could make desalination plants and power grids far more efficient.
exercises.translation: Mühendisler bazı malzemelerin çok düşük sıcaklıklarda elektrik direncini tamamen yitirmesi olan süperiletkenliğin tuzdan arındırma tesislerini ve elektrik şebekelerini çok daha verimli kılabileceğini umuyor.

exercises.question: During ----, small molecules link together into long chains, which is how chemists synthesize plastics; the derivation of the word, from Greek for ‘many parts’, reflects this, and many such plastics are now designed to be biodegradable or recyclable.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘polymerization’ (polimerleşme): küçük moleküllerin uzun zincirler oluşturması. ‘desalination’ (tuzdan arındırma), ‘modulation’ (modülasyon), ‘sequestration’ (depolama) ve ‘authentication’ (kimlik doğrulama) molekül zinciri kurmaz.

exercises.text: In an engine, each ___ moves up and down inside a cylinder, and a coolant, controlled by a thermostat, circulates around the cylinders to stop the metal from overheating and the parts from vibrating loose.
exercises.translation: Bir motorda her piston bir silindirin içinde aşağı yukarı hareket eder; bir termostatla denetlenen soğutucu sıvı da metalin aşırı ısınmasını ve parçaların titreşip gevşemesini önlemek için silindirlerin çevresinde dolaşır.

nodes.title: Ünite testi
nodes.description: 15 soruluk ünite testi; geçmek için %80 doğru yap

exercises.question: A minor ---- in the navigational software, caused by poor interoperability with an older system, disrupted the landing sequence, and the unmanned rover crashed into the lunar surface instead of touching down gently.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘glitch’ (aksaklık): sorun ‘software’ içinde, yani bir yazılım hatası. ‘payload’ (faydalı yük), ‘actuator’ (eyleyici) ve ‘antenna’ (anten) yazılımın parçası değildir; ‘hologram’ (hologram) da inişi bozamaz.

exercises.question: The groundbreaking telescope, which will also track dangerous asteroids, will study the light of distant galaxies and of a nearby nebula to answer questions in ---- about how the cosmos began and how it may end.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘cosmology’ (kozmoloji): evrenin başlangıcı ve sonu kozmolojinin konusudur. ‘meteorology’ (hava bilimi), ‘oceanography’ (okyanus bilimi), ‘geology’ (yerbilim) ve ‘cryptography’ (şifreleme bilimi) galaksilerle ilgilenmez.

exercises.question: Farmers now use ----, some fully autonomous and carrying a camera as their only payload, to survey their fields from the air, and these small unmanned aircraft have revolutionized the way crops are monitored.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘drones’ (insansız hava araçları): ‘small unmanned aircraft’ tanımı bunu verir. ‘rovers’ (gezgin araçlar) yerde gider; ‘actuators’ (eyleyiciler), ‘holograms’ (hologramlar) ve ‘pistons’ (pistonlar) uçan araç değildir.

exercises.question: The airline is ramping up its use of ----, made from used cooking oil and farm waste, to reduce the carbon and particulate emissions of its aerospace operations.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘biofuel’ (biyoyakıt): atık yağdan üretilen ve emisyonu azaltan yakıt. ‘coolant’ (soğutucu), ‘lubricant’ (yağlayıcı) ve ‘reagent’ (ayıraç) yakıt değildir; ‘magma’ (magma) da yemek yağından üretilmez.

exercises.question: Many technology firms ---- their users’ data so that, even after a successful cyberattack, hackers cannot decrypt the stolen files without a key.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘encrypt’ (şifrelemek): anahtar olmadan okunamayan veri şifrelenmiş veridir. ‘decrypt’ (şifre çözmek) tam tersidir; ‘digitize’ (sayısallaştırmak) ve ‘compress’ (sıkıştırmak) veriyi okunmaz yapmaz; ‘emulate’ (öykünmek) de anlamsızdır.

exercises.question: Researchers in astrophysics have ---- that the strange cosmic signal, whose modulation repeats every eighteen minutes, comes from a supernova remnant or a previously unknown type of neutron star, although they admit that more observations are needed to test the idea.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘hypothesized’ (varsaydı): fikir henüz sınanmamış bir açıklamadır (‘test the idea’). ‘digitized’ (sayısallaştırdı), ‘retrofitted’ (sonradan donattı), ‘encrypted’ (şifreledi) ve ‘oxidized’ (oksitledi) ‘that’ cümlesiyle bir görüş bildirmez.

exercises.question: In robotics and in modern cars, ---- convert electrical signals into physical movement, often through pneumatic systems, opening valves, adjusting the brakes or making the steering wheel vibrate to warn the driver.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘actuators’ (eyleyiciler): elektrik sinyalini harekete çeviren parçalar. ‘anodes’ (anotlar), ‘antennas’ (antenler), ‘pixels’ (pikseller) ve ‘firewalls’ (güvenlik duvarları) fiziksel hareket üretmez.

exercises.question: Because the rock beneath the city is highly ----, rainwater quickly sinks through it into the aquifer below, and the risk of surface flooding is low.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘permeable’ (geçirgen): yağmur suyu kayadan hızla süzülüyor. ‘impermeable’ (geçirimsiz) tam tersidir; ‘viscous’ (ağdalı), ‘biometric’ (biyometrik) ve ‘orbital’ (yörüngesel) kayanın su geçirme özelliğini anlatmaz.

exercises.question: Bones from the last ---- period show that mammoths and other large terrestrial animals once lived in what is now southern Europe, when thick ice sheets covered much of the continent.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘glacial’ (buzul): ‘thick ice sheets’ buzul dönemini anlatır. ‘lunar’ (Ay’a ait), ‘aquatic’ (suya ait), ‘atmospheric’ (atmosferik) ve ‘volcanic’ (volkanik) bir dönem adı olarak buzla örtülü kıtayı anlatmaz.

exercises.question: Engineers ---- the old aircraft with modern navigational equipment and a more efficient coolant system, a common practice in aeronautics, which streamlined maintenance and proved cheaper than replacing the whole fleet.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘retrofitted’ (sonradan donattı): eski uçaklara yeni ekipman eklendi. ‘decrypted’ (şifresini çözdü), ‘oxidized’ (oksitledi), ‘synthesized’ (sentezledi) ve ‘compressed’ (sıkıştırdı) ‘with modern equipment’ ile anlam kurmaz.

exercises.question: Although machine learning, a branch of artificial intelligence, has made translation software remarkably accurate, ----.
options: it is now used by millions of people every day
it still struggles with jokes, idioms and texts that depend on cultural knowledge
because it is trained on huge collections of text
which is why it has completely supplanted human translators
and its accuracy continues to improve each year
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘it still struggles with jokes, idioms…’: ‘although’ başarıyla çelişen bir sınırlama ister. ‘used by millions’ ve ‘continues to improve’ karşıtlık değil devam bildirir; ‘because it is trained…’ ve ‘which is why…’ ana cümle kurmaz.

exercises.question: ----, the spacecraft, despite its unusual orbital path, was able to send back detailed images of the comet’s surface.
options: Although its camera had failed shortly after launch
Unless it could safely cross the asteroid belt
Thanks to a powerful antenna and an advanced signal modulation system
Even though the spacecraft lost all contact with Earth
Before the comet was discovered by astronomers
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘Thanks to a powerful antenna…’: güçlü anten ve sinyal sistemi görüntü göndermeyi açıklar. ‘Although its camera had failed’ ve ‘Even though… lost all contact’ sonuçla çelişir; ‘Unless it could…’ gerçekleşmiş bir sonucu koşula bağlayamaz; ‘Before the comet was discovered’ da mantıksızdır.

exercises.question: If a neural network is trained only on images of light-skinned faces, ----.
options: it would have recognized every user equally well
the training process had been completed much faster
so engineers prefer to use smaller data sets
its biometric checks are likely to make more errors with darker-skinned users
whereas older systems relied on fingerprints
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘its biometric checks are likely to make more errors…’: tek tip veriyle eğitilen sistem farklı yüzlerde hata yapar; birinci tip koşul cümlesine ‘are likely to’ uyar. ‘would have recognized’ ve ‘had been completed’ zaman uyumunu bozar; ‘so engineers prefer…’ ve ‘whereas older systems…’ koşulun sonucunu vermez.

exercises.passage: Nanoparticles, visible only through electron microscopy, are attracting attention in the nascent field of nanomedicine because, at the nanoscale, they can pass through biological barriers that larger molecules cannot. Researchers are designing particles that carry drugs directly to tumours, sparing healthy tissue. However, some studies suggest that nanoparticles may build up in the liver and other organs, and their long-term effects remain unclear. Regulators are therefore asking for more safety data before such treatments are widely approved.
exercises.question: It is clear from the passage that ----.
options: nanoparticles cannot pass through biological barriers
regulators have already approved most nanoparticle treatments
nanoparticles damage healthy tissue more than tumours
larger molecules are better at reaching tumours
the long-term safety of medical nanoparticles has not yet been established
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘the long-term safety… has not yet been established’: uzun vadeli etkiler belirsiz ve düzenleyiciler daha fazla veri istiyor. Metne göre parçacıklar engelleri geçebildiği için ‘cannot pass’ yanlıştır; tedaviler henüz yaygın onay almadığından ‘already approved’ yanlıştır; sağlıklı doku korunduğu için ‘damage healthy tissue’ yanlıştır; ‘larger molecules’ ise engelleri geçemez.

exercises.passage: Desalination, the removal of salt from seawater, supplies drinking water to millions of people in dry regions. The process is reliable, but it consumes large amounts of energy and produces a salty waste called brine; research in oceanography shows that brine can harm aquatic life when it is pumped back into the sea. Engineers are therefore testing plants powered by solar energy and looking for ways to turn brine into useful minerals.
exercises.question: According to the passage, one drawback of desalination is that ----.
options: its waste product can harm marine ecosystems
it cannot provide water in dry regions
it produces water that is unsafe to drink
solar energy cannot be used to power it
it is too unreliable for large cities
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘its waste product can harm marine ecosystems’: tuzlu atık (brine) denizdeki canlılara zarar verebilir. Kurak bölgelere su sağladığı için ‘cannot provide water’ yanlıştır; içme suyu ürettiği için ‘unsafe to drink’ yanlıştır; güneş enerjili tesisler denendiği için ‘solar energy cannot’ yanlıştır; süreç güvenilir olduğundan ‘too unreliable’ da yanlıştır.

units.title: Sağlık ve yaşam bilimleri III
units.description: Patojenden gen tedavisine: virulent, congenital, circadian, zoonotic, homeostasis…
units.guide:
Bu ünite **Kelime bankası 1–3**'ün ardından gelen katman: sağlık ve yaşam bilimleri III. Sınavın son haftalarında YÖKDİL Sağlık ve YDS fen metinlerinde karşına çıkacak ileri düzey tıp, genetik ve beyin terimleri.

## Kelime aileleri
- *virulent → virulence*; *transmit → transmissible*
- *digest → digestion → digestive*
- *inherit → inheritance → heritability*
- *vaccinate → vaccination*; *inoculate → inoculation*
- *metabolize → metabolism → metabolic*
- *recuperate → recuperation*; *convalesce → convalescence*

## Türklerin sık yaptığı 3 hata
- **incurable ≠ untreatable:** *incurable* bir hastalık tamamen geçmez ama çoğu zaman tedavi edilebilir (*treatable*); ikisini eş anlamlı sanma.
- **disinfectant ≠ antiseptic:** *disinfectant* yüzeyler için, *antiseptic* cilt ve yara içindir.
- **congenital ≠ inherited:** *congenital* 'doğuştan' demektir; her doğuştan bozukluk kalıtsal değildir. Edatlara da dikkat: *predisposition **to***, *vaccinate **against***, *recuperate **from***.

## Nasıl çalışmalı
- Kökleri kullan: *neuro-* sinir, *osteo-* kemik, *-itis* iltihap, *anti-* karşı, *-genic* üreten. YDS'de bilmediğin bir terimi çoğu zaman kökünden çözersin.
- Her terimi eşdizimiyle öğren: *a lethal dose*, *a blood clot*, *circadian rhythm*, *a skin graft*.
- **Kelime kartları** ekranında kartları 1., 3. ve 7. günlerde tekrar et: aralıklı tekrar unutmayı yavaşlatır. Her gün iki terimle kendi cümleni kur; bellekten geri çağırma (retrieval practice) bilgiyi kalıcı yapar.

nodes.title: Kelimeler 1: Patojen ve pıhtı
nodes.description: pathogenic, virulent, clot, congenital… 28 kelime

exercises.question: Hospital kitchens must be kept ----, because patients recovering from a haemorrhage or a blood clot are especially vulnerable to pathogenic bacteria from the gastrointestinal tract.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘hygienic’ (hijyenik): hastaları mikroplardan korumak için mutfakların temiz, mikropsuz tutulması gerekir. ‘congenital’ (doğuştan), ‘neonatal’ (yenidoğana ait), ‘degenerative’ (dejeneratif) ve ‘intestinal’ (bağırsağa ait) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: Chronic ___ and infertility are both more common among night-shift workers, and some sleeping pills that act on a neurotransmitter in the brain lose their potency over time.
exercises.translation: Kronik uykusuzluk ve kısırlık gece vardiyasında çalışanlarda daha yaygındır; beyindeki bir sinir ileticisine etki eden bazı uyku hapları zamanla etki gücünü yitirir.

exercises.question: The ---- industry has developed a drug that dissolves a blood clot within hours, but its potency falls if it is not kept cool, and an overdose can cause a lethal haemorrhage.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘pharmaceutical’ (ilaçla ilgili): ilaç geliştiren sanayi ilaç sanayisidir (the pharmaceutical industry). ‘gastrointestinal’ (mide-bağırsak), ‘sterile’ (steril), ‘lethal’ (ölümcül) ve ‘digestive’ (sindirimle ilgili) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: After losing a leg in the accident, he was fitted with a modern ___, and months of physiotherapy helped him walk again despite degenerative changes in his spinal joints.
exercises.translation: Kazada bacağını kaybettikten sonra ona modern bir protez takıldı ve omurga eklemlerindeki dejeneratif değişikliklere rağmen aylarca süren fizik tedavi yeniden yürümesine yardım etti.

exercises.question: People who inherit a genetic ---- to thyroid disease will not inevitably become ill, but they should have their endocrine system checked regularly.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘predisposition’ (yatkınlık): ‘genetic predisposition to’ bir hastalığa genetik yatkınlık demektir ve hastalanmanın kesin olmadığını anlatır. ‘prosthesis’ (protez), ‘insomnia’ (uykusuzluk), ‘disinfectant’ (dezenfektan) ve ‘physiotherapy’ (fizik tedavi) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: Fibre aids digestion and keeps the ___ system and intestinal bacteria healthy, reducing gastrointestinal complaints, while iron-rich food helps to prevent anaemia.
exercises.translation: Lif sindirime yardım eder ve sindirim sistemini ve bağırsak bakterilerini sağlıklı tutar; mide-bağırsak şikâyetlerini azaltır; demirden zengin besinler ise kansızlığı önlemeye yardım eder.

exercises.question: Alcohol and severe anaemia in the mother can harm the developing ---- in the womb, and doctors in neonatal units see many babies born with congenital problems caused by drinking.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘foetus’ (cenin): annenin alkolü ve ağır kansızlığı rahimdeki cenine zarar verir; ‘developing foetus’ gelişmekte olan cenindir. ‘digestion’ (sindirim), ‘neurotransmitter’ (nörotransmiter), ‘infertility’ (kısırlık) ve ‘potency’ (etki gücü) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: Cleaners wipe every surface with ___, and nurses use sterile instruments, since even one virulent strain can spread quickly through a ward.
exercises.translation: Temizlikçiler her yüzeyi dezenfektanla siliyor, hemşireler steril alet kullanıyor; çünkü tek bir öldürücü suş bile koğuşta hızla yayılabilir.

exercises.text: Bazı çocuklar ölümcül bir hastalığı kalıtımla alır.
answers: Some children inherit a lethal disease.
Some children inherit a fatal disease.

nodes.title: Kelimeler 2: Hormonlar ve ritim
nodes.description: circadian, melatonin, posture, placenta… 28 kelime

exercises.question: Bright screens late at night suppress ----, a hormone that, unlike a neurotransmitter, travels in the bloodstream, disturbing the circadian rhythm and leading to insomnia and daytime exhaustion.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘melatonin’ (melatonin): karanlıkta salgılanan uyku hormonu melatonindir; ekran ışığı onu baskılayıp uykuyu bozar. ‘adrenaline’ (adrenalin), ‘testosterone’ (testosteron), ‘placenta’ (plasenta) ve ‘nausea’ (bulantı) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: Poor ___ at a desk can strain the spinal muscles and trigger migraines, and physiotherapy often helps more than painkillers.
exercises.translation: Masada kötü duruş omurga kaslarını zorlayabilir ve migreni tetikleyebilir; fizik tedavi çoğu zaman ağrı kesicilerden daha çok işe yarar.

exercises.question: Falling ---- levels after menopause speed up bone loss, and an underactive thyroid can make it worse, which is why osteoporosis and arthritis are so common among older women in geriatric wards.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘oestrogen’ (östrojen): menopozdan sonra düşen hormon östrojendir; ‘oestrogen levels’ kalıbı da bunu gösterir. ‘ulcer’ (ülser), ‘syringe’ (şırınga), ‘posture’ (duruş) ve ‘womb’ (rahim) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: Some patients with stomach ulcers try ___ remedies or acupuncture instead of pharmaceutical drugs, but their doctors prefer a holistic approach supported by evidence.
exercises.translation: Mide ülseri olan bazı hastalar ilaç sanayisinin ürünleri yerine bitkisel ilaçlar ya da akupunktur deniyor, ama doktorları kanıta dayalı bütüncül bir yaklaşımı tercih ediyor.

exercises.question: Patients who take ---- for depression are sometimes afraid of dependency or nausea, but most of these drugs are not addictive in the way that narcotics are.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘antidepressants’ (antidepresanlar): depresyon için alınan ilaçlar antidepresanlardır. ‘ventilators’ (solunum cihazları), ‘syringes’ (şırıngalar), ‘placentas’ (plasentalar) ve ‘ulcers’ (ülserler) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: When people with a phobia see what they fear, a sudden rush of ___ makes the heart beat faster, and many feel nausea and exhaustion afterwards.
exercises.translation: Fobisi olan kişiler korktukları şeyi gördüğünde ani bir adrenalin artışı kalbi hızlandırır; birçoğu sonrasında bulantı ve bitkinlik hisseder.

exercises.question: Soon after fertilization, the ---- begins to form; it carries oxygen from the mother’s bloodstream to the foetus in the womb, and damage to it can lead to miscarriage.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘placenta’ (plasenta): anneden bebeğe oksijen taşıyan organ plasentadır. ‘posture’ (duruş), ‘acupuncture’ (akupunktur), ‘zoology’ (zooloji) ve ‘nausea’ (bulantı) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: Patients on a ___ in intensive care cannot cough or swallow by reflex, so nurses use a syringe to give drugs directly into the bloodstream.
exercises.translation: Yoğun bakımda solunum cihazına bağlı hastalar refleksle öksüremez ve yutkunamaz; bu yüzden hemşireler ilaçları şırıngayla doğrudan kana verir.

exercises.text: Testosteron ve östrojen düzeyleri yaşla değişir.
answers: Testosterone and oestrogen levels change with age.
Oestrogen and testosterone levels change with age.

nodes.title: Kelimeler 3: Beyin, göz ve klinik
nodes.description: hippocampus, recessive, latent, referral… 28 kelime

exercises.question: Damage to the ---- often causes amnesia, because this part of the brain stores new memories, and it also helps us learn fear, which may explain why phobias are so hard to unlearn.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘hippocampus’ (hipokampus): yeni anıları depolayan beyin bölgesi hipokampustur. ‘retina’ (retina), ‘cataract’ (katarakt), ‘placenta’ (plasenta) ve ‘reflex’ (refleks) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: ___ babies, many of whom are born after problems with the placenta, often need weeks of hospitalization in neonatal units, and a midwife visits the family at home after they are discharged.
exercises.translation: Birçoğu plasenta sorunlarından sonra doğan erken doğmuş bebeklerin çoğu zaman yenidoğan ünitelerinde haftalarca yatması gerekir ve taburcu olduktan sonra bir ebe aileyi evde ziyaret eder.

exercises.question: The gene for cystic fibrosis is ----, so a child develops this congenital disease only after inheriting two faulty copies; although still incurable, it is far more treatable than in the past, and gene therapy may one day cure it.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘recessive’ (çekinik): hastalığın ancak iki bozuk kopya alındığında ortaya çıkması genin çekinik olduğunu gösterir. ‘anaerobic’ (oksijensiz), ‘premature’ (erken doğmuş), ‘antiseptic’ (antiseptik) ve ‘epidemiological’ (epidemiyolojik) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: Tuberculosis and some intestinal parasites can stay ___ in the body for years; such infections are treatable, and epidemiological studies show that only one infection in ten ever becomes active.
exercises.translation: Verem ve bazı bağırsak parazitleri vücutta yıllarca gizli kalabilir; bu enfeksiyonlar tedavi edilebilir ve epidemiyolojik çalışmalar her on enfeksiyondan yalnızca birinin etkinleştiğini gösteriyor.

exercises.question: Children with ---- find reading and spelling unusually hard; the condition has nothing to do with intelligence and, unlike autism, it does not affect social communication; brain plasticity also means that early reading support works best.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘dyslexia’ (disleksi): okuma ve yazım güçlüğü disleksidir. ‘amnesia’ (hafıza kaybı), ‘cataract’ (katarakt), ‘menopause’ (menopoz) ve ‘insomnia’ (uykusuzluk) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: Experts in zoology warn that rats and other ___ carry bacteria into hospital kitchens, so staff use antibacterial sprays and antiseptic wipes every day.
exercises.translation: Zooloji uzmanları sıçanların ve diğer kemirgenlerin hastane mutfaklarına bakteri taşıdığı konusunda uyarıyor; bu yüzden personel her gün antibakteriyel sprey ve antiseptik mendil kullanır.

exercises.question: Older adults with visual ---- caused by a cataract or by damage to the retina should get a referral to an eye specialist as early as possible.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘impairment’ (bozukluk): ‘visual impairment’ görme bozukluğudur ve katarakt ile retina hasarı buna yol açar. ‘hospitalization’ (hastaneye yatış), ‘graft’ (nakil), ‘infusion’ (damar içi verme) ve ‘reflex’ (refleks) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: The drug is given as an ___ over two hours, and patients with a pacemaker or those taking antidepressants are watched closely for changes in heart rhythm.
exercises.translation: İlaç iki saat boyunca damardan verilir ve kalp pili olan ya da antidepresan kullanan hastalar kalp ritmindeki değişiklikler açısından yakından izlenir.

exercises.text: Sporcular oksijensiz egzersizden sonra su içmelidir.
answers: Athletes should hydrate after anaerobic exercise.

nodes.title: Kelimeler 4: Mikroptan gen tedavisine
nodes.description: zoonotic, inoculate, senescence, homeostasis… 28 kelime

exercises.question: Most emerging infectious diseases are ----: microbes that once stayed in wild animals now jump to humans as forests are cleared, which is why experts in zoology also study bats and rodents.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘zoonotic’ (hayvandan insana bulaşan): hayvandan insana geçen hastalıklar zoonotiktir. ‘curative’ (tedavi edici), ‘prophylactic’ (koruyucu), ‘neurodegenerative’ (nörodejeneratif) ve ‘biomedical’ (biyomedikal) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: In the village, a midwife and two nurses plan to ___ every child against measles, since a strong immune system in most children protects the whole community.
exercises.translation: Köyde bir ebe ve iki hemşire her çocuğu kızamığa karşı aşılamayı planlıyor; çünkü çocukların çoğunda güçlü bir bağışıklık sistemi bütün toplumu korur.

exercises.question: Because the new strain is highly transmissible but its ---- is low, most infected people simply rest, hydrate and recover at home after a short convalescence.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘virulence’ (öldürücülük): kolay bulaşan ama hafif seyreden bir suşun öldürücülüğü (virulence) düşüktür. ‘heritability’ (kalıtsallık derecesi), ‘homeostasis’ (homeostaz), ‘camouflage’ (kamuflaj) ve ‘senescence’ (yaşlanma (hücresel)) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: After her skin graft she needed six weeks to ___ at home; during this convalescence, her doctors checked a biomarker of inflammation in her blood.
exercises.translation: Deri naklinden sonra evde toparlanmak için altı haftaya ihtiyaç duydu; bu iyileşme döneminde doktorları kanındaki bir iltihap biyobelirtecini kontrol etti.

exercises.question: Researchers hope that a simple blood ---- or a scan of the retina will reveal neurodegenerative diseases long before the nervous system is badly damaged by disease or by senescence.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘biomarker’ (biyobelirteç): hastalığı önceden gösteren ölçülebilir kan maddesi biyobelirteçtir. ‘carcinogen’ (kanserojen madde), ‘coral’ (mercan), ‘malady’ (hastalık) ve ‘microbe’ (mikrop) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: In the eighteenth century, doctors began to ___ healthy people with material from mild smallpox cases, a risky but effective prophylactic method.
exercises.translation: On sekizinci yüzyılda doktorlar sağlıklı insanları hafif çiçek vakalarından alınan maddeyle aşılamaya başladı; riskli ama etkili, koruyucu bir yöntemdi bu.

exercises.question: Older patients ---- many drugs more slowly, so a dose that is curative for a young adult, especially when combined with herbal remedies, may cause poisoning in an elderly patient.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘metabolize’ (metabolize etmek): yaşlılar ilaçları vücutta daha yavaş işler; bu yüzden aynı doz zehirlenmeye yol açabilir. ‘inoculate’ (aşılamak), ‘vaccinate’ (aşılamak), ‘recuperate’ (iyileşmek) ve ‘hydrate’ (su vermek) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: Rising sea temperatures are killing ___ reefs, among the richest habitats in the biosphere, and with them many fish whose camouflage once protected them from predators.
exercises.translation: Yükselen deniz sıcaklıkları biyosferin en zengin yaşam alanları arasındaki mercan resiflerini öldürüyor ve onlarla birlikte kamuflajı bir zamanlar onları avcılardan koruyan birçok balığı da.

exercises.text: Isınan denizler mercanları ve kamuflaj ustası balıkları tehdit ediyor.
answers: Warming seas threaten coral and fish with clever camouflage.
Warming seas threaten corals and fish with clever camouflage.

exercises.passage: Humans share the biosphere with countless microbes, and only a small fraction of them are pathogenic. When forests are cleared, however, people and their livestock come into closer contact with wild animals and rodents, and (1)---- diseases can jump to humans. Epidemiological studies of such outbreaks try to establish the etiology of a new malady quickly, because a virus that is highly transmissible may spread across continents within weeks. Its (2)---- also matters: a strain that kills most of its hosts is lethal but often burns out, whereas a milder one may circulate for years. Some viruses remain (3)---- in the body long after the first infection and become active again when the immune system weakens. Experts therefore stress prevention. Countries that (4)---- health workers early and keep their hospitals hygienic and well supplied with disinfectant reduce hospitalization dramatically. Prophylactic drugs protect travellers against a few virulent infections, but for many such diseases no curative treatment exists yet, and severely ill patients may need a ventilator while their bodies fight the infection.

exercises.passage: Why do we age? Part of the answer lies in cellular (1)----, the process in which cells stop dividing and release substances that damage nearby tissue. Over decades, this process contributes to degenerative conditions such as arthritis and osteoporosis and to neurodegenerative diseases that attack the nervous system and cause cognitive impairment. Damage to the (2)----, a small region of the brain that stores new memories, explains why mild amnesia is often the first sign of Alzheimer’s disease. Twin studies suggest that the heritability of a long life is surprisingly modest; lifestyle seems to matter more than the genes we inherit. Wholesome food, regular exercise and good sleep help the body maintain (3)----, while chronic insomnia and exhaustion upset this balance. Reflexes slow with age, but the good news is that brain (4)---- persists into old age: older adults who learn a language or an instrument build new connections. Biomedical researchers are now testing drugs that remove ageing cells, and early trials of gene therapy are under way, although none of these treatments is yet available outside the laboratory.

exercises.question: Doctors were unable to establish the ---- of the illness; it was not caused by a recessive gene, and they suspected that a carcinogen in the factory’s water supply was to blame.

exercises.text: Loneliness has been described as a modern ___ that harms health as seriously as smoking, and geriatric doctors now ask older patients about their social lives.

exercises.question: Air pollution has a deleterious effect on health, and fine particulate matter is now listed among the known ----, since biomedical studies show that it can damage the DNA of lung cells.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘carcinogens’ (kanserojen maddeler): DNA’ya zarar verip kansere yol açabilen maddeler kanserojenlerdir. ‘biomarkers’ (biyobelirteçler), ‘microbes’ (mikroplar), ‘prostheses’ (protezler) ve ‘antiseptics’ (antiseptikler) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.question: Unlike ---- treatment, which tries to eliminate the disease, palliative care takes a holistic approach, sometimes including massage or acupuncture, to relieve pain and improve the quality of life of patients whose illness cannot be cured.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘curative’ (tedavi edici): hastalığı ortadan kaldırmaya çalışan tedavi, iyileştirici (curative) tedavidir ve palyatif bakımın karşıtıdır. ‘congenital’ (doğuştan), ‘intestinal’ (bağırsağa ait), ‘circadian’ (günlük (biyolojik) ritme ait) ve ‘spinal’ (omurgaya ait) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.question: Drones now deliver vaccines and blood to remote clinics, where a shortage of ---- syringes and infusion bags once forced nurses to reuse needles.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘sterile’ (steril): iğnelerin yeniden kullanılması mikropsuz şırınga eksikliğinden kaynaklanır. ‘lethal’ (ölümcül), ‘latent’ (gizli), ‘virulent’ (öldürücü) ve ‘recessive’ (çekinik) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.question: Hackers launched a cyberattack on the hospital network, delaying the ---- of patients with cataracts to specialists for nearly a week.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘referral’ (sevk): hastaların uzmana gönderilmesi sevktir (referral to a specialist). ‘posture’ (duruş), ‘camouflage’ (kamuflaj), ‘migraine’ (migren) ve ‘reflex’ (refleks) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.question: Smokers have a higher risk of stomach ---- and other digestive problems, although most of these sores are caused by bacteria rather than by tobacco or stress.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘ulcers’ (ülserler): ‘stomach ulcer’ mide ülseridir ve çoğu bakteriden kaynaklanır. ‘phobias’ (fobiler), ‘reflexes’ (refleksler), ‘syringes’ (şırıngalar) ve ‘grafts’ (doku nakilleri) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.question: The groundbreaking study showed that the ---- of height, like that of autism or dyslexia, is high in well-fed populations, meaning that most differences between individuals there reflect their genes.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘heritability’ (kalıtsallık derecesi): bireyler arasındaki farkların genlerden kaynaklanma derecesi kalıtsallıktır. ‘convalescence’ (nekahet), ‘impairment’ (bozukluk), ‘dependency’ (bağımlılık) ve ‘exhaustion’ (bitkinlik) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.question: Although the new vaccine proved highly effective in clinical trials, ----.
options: many parents still refused to inoculate their children because of misleading claims online
it was therefore approved by regulators within a few weeks
because the virus had become far less transmissible
which explains why it protected the immune system so well
unless doctors vaccinate patients before the trial begins
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘many parents still refused to vaccinate their children because of misleading claims online’: ‘although’ aşının etkili olmasına karşıt bir sonuç ister, ailelerin aşıyı reddetmesi bu karşıtlığı kurar. ‘approved’ ve ‘protected’ seçenekleri başarıyı sürdürür, karşıtlık kurmaz; ‘because the virus…’ ana cümle değildir; ‘unless’ ile kurulan koşul geçmişteki denemeyle uyuşmaz.

exercises.question: ----, the hospital was able to reduce infections after surgery by almost half.
options: Although its antiseptic supplies had run out completely
Because surgeons ignored the new guidelines
By introducing stricter hygienic rules and using sterile instruments in every operation
Unless more patients are referred to specialists
Even though pathogenic bacteria were never detected in its wards
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘By introducing stricter hygienic rules and using sterile instruments in every operation’: enfeksiyonun azalmasının yolu hijyen ve steril alettir. ‘supplies had run out’ ve ‘ignored the new guidelines’ başarıyı açıklamaz, tersini bekletir; ‘Unless…’ şimdiki zamanla geçmiş sonucu bağlayamaz; ‘never detected’ karşıtlık kurmaz, mantıksızdır.

exercises.question: Premature babies are particularly vulnerable to infection ----.
options: so that midwives can visit them at home more often
unless their parents inherited a recessive gene
which is why they rarely need hospitalization
even though they are born earlier than expected
because their immune system is not yet fully developed
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘because their immune system is not yet fully developed’: savunmasızlığın nedeni bağışıklık sisteminin gelişmemiş olmasıdır. ‘midwives can visit’ amaç bildirir, neden değil; ‘recessive gene’ koşulu ilgisizdir; ‘rarely need hospitalization’ savunmasızlıkla çelişir; ‘earlier than expected’ ise karşıtlık değil nedendir, ‘even though’ uymaz.

exercises.passage: Night-shift workers often suffer from insomnia, migraines and exhaustion because their circadian rhythm is constantly disturbed. Light at night suppresses melatonin, while adrenaline and other stress hormones are released at the wrong time of day. Meals eaten at unusual hours upset digestion, since the body metabolizes food differently at night, and this disruption of homeostasis may explain other effects: women on night shifts report an earlier menopause, and men show lower testosterone levels. Epidemiological studies have linked long-term shift work to ulcers, dependency on sleeping pills or narcotics and diabetes, especially in workers with a genetic predisposition to it. Researchers stress, however, that these studies show associations rather than proof of cause, and that wholesome food, regular sleep times and dark bedrooms can reduce much of the harm.
exercises.question: According to the passage, the link between shift work and disease ----.
options: is caused mainly by poor posture at work
affects only workers who take melatonin
cannot be reduced by any change in lifestyle
has been observed but not proven to be causal
has been disproved by recent research
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘has been observed but not proven to be causal’: araştırmacılar çalışmaların neden-sonuç değil ilişki gösterdiğini vurguluyor. ‘posture’ ve ‘take melatonin’ metinde yoktur; ‘any change in lifestyle’ metinle çelişir, çünkü sağlıklı beslenme ve düzenli uyku zararı azaltır; ‘disproved’ da yanlıştır.

exercises.passage: Antibacterial soaps became popular in the 1990s, when they were promoted as more hygienic than ordinary soap. Yet trials found that they remove no more germs than soap and water, and regulators later banned several of their ingredients after cases of poisoning in children who had swallowed them. Some scientists fear that their overuse helps bacteria develop resistance, much as the careless use of antibiotics has done. Antiseptic products still have an important place in hospitals, where sterile conditions are vital, but at home, the authors conclude, simple handwashing is just as effective.
exercises.question: It can be understood from the passage that antibacterial soaps ----.
options: are essential for creating sterile conditions at home
were banned because they caused allergies
offer no clear advantage over ordinary soap in the home
should replace antiseptic products in hospitals
kill far more germs than soap and water
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘offer no clear advantage over ordinary soap in the home’: denemeler bu sabunların sıradan sabundan fazla mikrop gidermediğini, evde el yıkamanın yeterli olduğunu gösteriyor. ‘essential’ ve ‘far more germs’ metinle çelişir; ‘allergies’ metinde geçmez; ‘replace antiseptic’ ise hastanelerdeki antiseptiklerin önemli olduğu bilgisiyle çelişir.

nodes.title: Ünite ödülü
nodes.description: Üniteyi bitir, bonus XP kazan

units.title: Toplum, hukuk ve ekonomi III
units.description: Savcıdan halk oylamasına: indict, acquittal, arbitration, pluralism, privatize…
units.guide:
Bu ünite **Kelime bankası 1–3**'ün ardından gelen katman: toplum, hukuk ve ekonomi III. YDS sosyal bilim metinlerinde ve haber dilinde sık geçen ceza hukuku, yargı, siyasal sistem ve ekonomi politikası terimleri.

## Kelime aileleri
- *acquit → acquittal*; *detain → detention → detainee*
- *embezzle → embezzlement*; *litigate → litigant → litigation*
- *culpable → culpability*; *abolish → abolition*
- *privatize → privatization* / *nationalize → nationalization*
- *stigma → stigmatize*; *mediate → mediator → mediation*
- *-cracy* 'yönetim': *theocracy, plutocracy*; *-archy*: *oligarchy, anarchy*

## Türklerin sık yaptığı 3 hata
- **arbitrator ≠ mediator:** hakemin (*arbitrator*) kararı bağlayıcıdır; arabulucu (*mediator*) yalnızca tarafların anlaşmasına yardım eder.
- **felony ≠ misdemeanour, murder ≠ manslaughter:** ağır suç / hafif suç; kasten öldürme / taksirle öldürme. Okuma sorularında bu ayrım cevabı değiştirir.
- **equitable ≠ equal; negligent ≠ negligible:** *equitable* 'hakkaniyetli', *negligent* 'ihmalkâr' demektir (*negligible* 'önemsiz'). Edatlar: *acquit sb **of** a crime*, *complicity **in***, *indict sb **on** charges of*.

## Nasıl çalışmalı
- Terimleri süreç sırasıyla öğren: *detain → indict → trial → acquit / imprisonment → parole*. Okuma parçasını bu zincir üzerinden izlemek kolaylaşır.
- Her kelimeyi eşdizimiyle çalış: *issue a subpoena*, *copyright infringement*, *universal suffrage*, *the stigma attached to*.
- **Kelime kartları** ekranında kartları 1., 3. ve 7. günlerde tekrar et (aralıklı tekrar); her gün iki terimle kendi cümleni kur, çünkü bellekten geri çağırmak (retrieval practice) bilgiyi kalıcı yapar.

nodes.title: Kelimeler 1: Suç ve yargılama
nodes.description: prosecutor, indict, perjury, felony… 28 kelime

exercises.question: The ---- argued that the defendant had committed perjury, since his affidavit contradicted the emails obtained through a subpoena.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘prosecutor’ (savcı): mahkemede sanığın suçunu kanıtlamaya çalışan kişi savcıdır. ‘regulator’ (düzenleyici kurum), ‘decree’ (kararname), ‘forgery’ (sahtecilik) ve ‘nepotism’ (kayırmacılık) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: Police may ___ a suspect for twenty-four hours, but longer detention requires a judge’s approval, together with evidence of fraudulent accounts or embezzlement.
exercises.translation: Polis bir şüpheliyi yirmi dört saat gözaltında tutabilir, ama daha uzun gözaltı için hâkim onayı ve hileli hesaplara ya da zimmete para geçirmeye dair kanıt gerekir.

exercises.question: After a grand jury voted to ---- the mayor for accepting a bribe, opponents also accused him of nepotism, since his nephew had won every city contract.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘indict’ (resmen suçlamak): büyük jürinin rüşvet alan belediye başkanı hakkında yaptığı şey onu resmen suçlamaktır (indict). ‘subsidize’ (sübvanse etmek), ‘abolish’ (kaldırmak), ‘liquidate’ (tasfiye etmek) ve ‘privatize’ (özelleştirmek) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: Shoplifting is usually a ___ punished with a fine, whereas armed robbery is a felony that can lead to long imprisonment under statutory sentencing rules.
exercises.translation: Mağazadan hırsızlık genellikle para cezasıyla cezalandırılan hafif bir suçtur; silahlı soygun ise yasal ceza kurallarına göre uzun hapse yol açabilen ağır bir suçtur.

exercises.question: Although the jury’s ---- of the officers angered many people, the judge noted that the evidence of their culpability presented by the prosecutor, including a deposition from the chief witness, had been weak.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘acquittal’ (beraat): jürinin polisleri aklaması, yani beraat kararı, halkı kızdırmış; zayıf kanıt da bunu açıklıyor. ‘extortion’ (şantaj), ‘forgery’ (sahtecilik), ‘infringement’ (ihlal) ve ‘deposition’ (yeminli ifade (mahkeme dışında)) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: After serving half of his sentence for ___, since he had produced counterfeit banknotes and passports, he was released on parole, and his probation officer must approve any job he takes.
exercises.translation: Sahte banknot ve pasaport ürettiği için aldığı sahtecilik cezasının yarısını çektikten sonra şartlı tahliye edildi; denetimli serbestlik görevlisinin aldığı her işi onaylaması gerekiyor.

exercises.question: The emperor’s ---- granted religious freedom to all his subjects, a principle later confirmed by a modern decree and by the jurisprudence of the constitutional court.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘edict’ (ferman): imparatorun verdiği resmî buyruk fermandır (edict). ‘felony’ (ağır suç), ‘misdemeanour’ (hafif suç), ‘subpoena’ (mahkemeye celp) ve ‘affidavit’ (yeminli yazılı ifade) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: The financial ___ fined the company after finding an infringement of the rules on consumer loans and evidence of extortion by its debt collectors.
exercises.translation: Finans düzenleyici kurumu, tüketici kredisi kurallarının ihlal edildiğini ve borç tahsildarlarının haraç topladığına dair kanıt bulduktan sonra şirkete para cezası verdi.

exercises.text: Bu küçük kural ihlali ağır bir suç değildir.
answers: This minor transgression is not a felony.
This small transgression is not a felony.

nodes.title: Kelimeler 2: Uyuşmazlık ve temsil
nodes.description: manslaughter, arbitration, suffrage, pluralism… 28 kelime

exercises.question: The gang used fishing boats to ---- migrants and counterfeit cigarettes across the sea, and its leaders now face charges of human trafficking and manslaughter after a boat sank.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘smuggle’ (kaçırmak (kaçakçılık yapmak)): göçmenleri denizden yasa dışı yollarla geçirmek kaçakçılıktır (smuggle). ‘litigate’ (dava açmak), ‘abolish’ (kaldırmak), ‘devalue’ (devalüe etmek) ve ‘nationalize’ (devletleştirmek) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: The inquiry found the company ___ because it had ignored statutory safety rules, and one culpable manager was ordered to pay restitution to the victims’ families.
exercises.translation: Soruşturma, yasal güvenlik kurallarını görmezden geldiği için şirketi ihmalkâr buldu; kusurlu bir yönetici de kurbanların ailelerine tazminat ödemeye mahkûm edildi.

exercises.question: Residents, advised by a local solicitor, obtained an ---- that stopped the airport expansion, but an appellate court later overturned it.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘injunction’ (ihtiyati tedbir): bir projeyi durduran mahkeme kararı ihtiyati tedbirdir (injunction). ‘ombudsman’ (kamu denetçisi), ‘oligarchy’ (oligarşi), ‘edict’ (ferman) ve ‘affidavit’ (yeminli yazılı ifade) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: Instead of slow, bureaucratic court procedures, the two firms chose ___, and an independent arbitrator decided the case within a month.
exercises.translation: İki firma yavaş, bürokratik mahkeme işlemleri yerine tahkimi seçti ve bağımsız bir hakem davayı bir ay içinde karara bağladı.

exercises.question: Women in the country won ---- in 1934, a milestone in their emancipation, and advocacy groups now campaign for more equitable representation in parliament.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘suffrage’ (oy hakkı): kadınların 1934’te kazandığı hak oy hakkıdır (suffrage). ‘burglary’ (hırsızlık (eve/binaya girerek)), ‘restitution’ (tazmin), ‘pluralism’ (çoğulculuk) ve ‘mediation’ (arabuluculuk) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: A former judge acted as ___ in the long dispute between bureaucrats in hierarchical ministries and the teachers’ union, and mediation finally ended the strike.
exercises.translation: Eski bir hâkim, hiyerarşik bakanlıklardaki bürokratlar ile öğretmen sendikası arasındaki uzun anlaşmazlıkta arabuluculuk yaptı ve arabuluculuk sonunda grevi bitirdi.

exercises.question: Critics claim the country is no longer a democracy but an ----, in which a few rich families and their lobbyists control parliament and the media, leaving little room for pluralism.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘oligarchy’ (oligarşi): birkaç zengin ailenin yönettiği sistem oligarşidir. ‘ombudsman’ (kamu denetçisi), ‘injunction’ (ihtiyati tedbir), ‘arbitrator’ (hakem (tahkimde)) ve ‘edict’ (ferman) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: Rapid ___ has pushed many destitute families into informal settlements, where underprivileged children rarely finish school and burglary is common.
exercises.translation: Hızlı kentleşme birçok muhtaç aileyi, imkânları kısıtlı çocukların okulu nadiren bitirdiği ve hırsızlığın yaygın olduğu kaçak yerleşimlere itti.

exercises.text: Hükümet eşitlikçi bir eğitim sistemini sübvanse ediyor.
answers: The government subsidizes an egalitarian education system.

nodes.title: Kelimeler 3: İdeoloji ve özgürleşme
nodes.description: globalization, socialism, abolition, collusion… 28 kelime

exercises.question: Critics of ---- argue that it has moved factory jobs to low-wage countries, and they support protectionist measures such as import quotas.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘globalization’ (küreselleşme): fabrika işlerini düşük ücretli ülkelere taşıyan süreç küreselleşmedir. ‘privatization’ (özelleştirme), ‘emancipation’ (özgürleşme), ‘abdication’ (tahttan feragat) ve ‘inauguration’ (göreve başlama töreni) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: After years of losses, the owners decided to ___ the company, a step that critics of privatization had long predicted.
exercises.translation: Yıllarca süren zararların ardından sahipler şirketi tasfiye etmeye karar verdi; özelleştirme eleştirmenleri bu adımı uzun zamandır öngörüyordu.

exercises.question: Supporters of ---- argue that the redistribution of wealth through taxes is fairer than charity from a wealthy philanthropist, although few want a return to communism.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘socialism’ (sosyalizm): servetin vergilerle yeniden dağıtımını savunan görüş sosyalizmdir. ‘anarchy’ (kargaşa), ‘abdication’ (tahttan feragat), ‘clergy’ (din adamları) ve ‘stigma’ (damga) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: Thousands attended the president’s ___, where she promised humanitarian aid for refugees and the empowerment of women in rural areas.
exercises.translation: Binlerce kişi cumhurbaşkanının göreve başlama törenine katıldı; o da törende mültecilere insani yardım ve kırsal bölgelerdeki kadınların güçlendirilmesi sözü verdi.

exercises.question: Campaigners who fought to ---- slavery in the nineteenth century saw abolition as only the first step towards the full emancipation of all people.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘abolish’ (kaldırmak): köleliği yasal olarak sona erdirmek onu kaldırmaktır (abolish). ‘liquidate’ (tasfiye etmek), ‘privatize’ (özelleştirmek), ‘monopolize’ (tekeline almak) ve ‘subsidize’ (sübvanse etmek) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: Members of the ___ joined the protests, warning that the country could slide into anarchy if the king’s abdication was not handled peacefully.
exercises.translation: Din adamları da protestolara katıldı ve kralın tahttan feragati barışçıl biçimde yönetilmezse ülkenin kargaşaya sürüklenebileceği konusunda uyardı.

exercises.question: The novel describes a ---- future in which an ideological party, or in some versions a theocracy, controls every citizen, the opposite of the utopian society its founders had promised.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘dystopian’ (distopik): her yurttaşın denetlendiği korkutucu gelecek distopiktir ve ütopik toplumun karşıtıdır. ‘protectionist’ (korumacı), ‘humanitarian’ (insani), ‘bureaucratic’ (bürokratik) ve ‘statutory’ (yasal) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: Investigators found evidence of ___ between the two firms, which had secretly agreed to fix prices, and the judiciary is now examining the complicity of a senior official.
exercises.translation: Müfettişler fiyatları gizlice belirlemek için anlaşan iki firma arasında gizli işbirliği kanıtı buldu; yargı şimdi üst düzey bir yetkilinin suç ortaklığını inceliyor.

exercises.text: Fail bir avukat tuttu.
answers: The perpetrator hired a solicitor.
The perpetrator hired a lawyer.

nodes.title: Kelimeler 4: Yönetim ve piyasa
nodes.description: acquit, plebiscite, monopolize, due process… 28 kelime

exercises.question: Juries rarely ---- defendants charged with money laundering, because bank records usually prove beyond doubt that the accused tried to embezzle or hide the funds.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘acquit’ (beraat ettirmek): kanıtlar güçlü olduğu için jüriler sanıkları nadiren beraat ettirir (acquit). ‘devalue’ (devalüe etmek), ‘nationalize’ (devletleştirmek), ‘monopolize’ (tekeline almak) ve ‘privatize’ (özelleştirmek) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: Critics say the law will ___ poor voters and expatriates, since many lack the documents now required, and that it contravenes the principle of equal suffrage.
exercises.translation: Eleştirmenler yasanın, birçoğu artık istenen belgelere sahip olmadığı için yoksul seçmenleri ve gurbetçileri oy hakkından yoksun bırakacağını ve eşit oy hakkı ilkesini çiğnediğini söylüyor.

exercises.question: Detaining suspects for months without trial, a practice familiar from dystopian novels, violates ----, a principle that protects civil liberties and lies at the heart of the social contract between citizens and the state.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘due process’ (hukuka uygun yargılama): yargılamasız gözaltı, hukuka uygun yargılama (due process) ilkesini çiğner. ‘money laundering’ (kara para aklama), ‘plutocracy’ (plütokrasi), ‘theocracy’ (teokrasi) ve ‘affluence’ (refah) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: When two firms ___ a market, prices rise, and speculators can make huge profits while many workers suffer from underemployment.
exercises.translation: İki firma bir piyasayı tekeline aldığında fiyatlar yükselir; birçok çalışan eksik istihdamdan muzdaripken spekülatörler büyük kâr elde edebilir.

exercises.question: In a ----, the clergy hold political power, whereas in a plutocracy the richest citizens rule, and under a despot one person decides everything.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘theocracy’ (teokrasi): din liderlerinin siyasi gücü elinde tuttuğu yönetim teokrasidir. ‘plebiscite’ (halk oylaması), ‘reparation’ (tazminat (savaş/haksızlık için)), ‘litigant’ (davacı ya da davalı) ve ‘speculator’ (spekülatör) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: The government plans to ___ the railways, which were nationalized after the war, arguing that private owners will invest more.
exercises.translation: Hükümet, savaştan sonra devletleştirilen demiryollarını özel sahiplerin daha çok yatırım yapacağını savunarak özelleştirmeyi planlıyor.

exercises.question: Societies that ---- former prisoners, stigmatize their families and marginalize them in the job market make it more likely that they will reoffend.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘ostracize’ (dışlamak): eski mahkûmları toplumdan dışlamak (ostracize) suçun tekrarlanma olasılığını artırır. ‘adjudicate’ (hüküm vermek), ‘devalue’ (devalüe etmek), ‘litigate’ (dava açmak) ve ‘embezzle’ (zimmetine para geçirmek) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: After the war, a special tribunal was set up to ___ claims for reparations, and each litigant had to prove the losses suffered.
exercises.translation: Savaştan sonra tazminat taleplerini karara bağlamak için özel bir mahkeme kuruldu ve her dava tarafı uğradığı kayıpları kanıtlamak zorundaydı.

exercises.text: Zorba hükümdar bütün muhaliflerini hapsetti.
answers: The despot incarcerated all of his opponents.
The despot incarcerated all his opponents.

nodes.title: Bağlamda
nodes.description: İki paragrafta yolsuzluk davası ve eşitsizlik üzerine terimleri bağlamda kullan

exercises.passage: When a senior official is suspected of corruption, the process usually begins quietly. Investigators may issue a (1)---- ordering banks to hand over documents or obtain an injunction freezing his accounts, and they may take sworn statements, such as an affidavit or a deposition from a former employee. If the evidence suggests embezzlement or that the official accepted a bribe, a prosecutor may ask a grand jury to (2)---- him. Cases involving money laundering are often complex, because the money passes through dozens of companies, some owned by expatriates abroad. At trial, the defence may argue that the official was merely negligent rather than culpable, and that his assistants acted without his knowledge, denying any (3)---- in their crimes. If he is convicted, the judge may order imprisonment and restitution of the stolen money; if the trial ends in acquittal, the prosecutor may turn to an appellate court, and victims may still litigate in a civil court. Throughout the process, the judiciary must respect (4)----: every defendant has the right to a fair hearing, however strong public anger may be.
exercises.question: (1) numaralı boşluk için en uygun kelimeyi seçin.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘subpoena’ (mahkemeye celp): bankaları belge vermeye zorlayan resmî emir celpnamedir. ‘quota’ (kota), ‘plebiscite’ (halk oylaması), ‘despot’ (despot) ve ‘felony’ (ağır suç) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.passage: When a senior official is suspected of corruption, the process usually begins quietly. Investigators may issue a (1)---- ordering banks to hand over documents or obtain an injunction freezing his accounts, and they may take sworn statements, such as an affidavit or a deposition from a former employee. If the evidence suggests embezzlement or that the official accepted a bribe, a prosecutor may ask a grand jury to (2)---- him. Cases involving money laundering are often complex, because the money passes through dozens of companies, some owned by expatriates abroad. At trial, the defence may argue that the official was merely negligent rather than culpable, and that his assistants acted without his knowledge, denying any (3)---- in their crimes. If he is convicted, the judge may order imprisonment and restitution of the stolen money; if the trial ends in acquittal, the prosecutor may turn to an appellate court, and victims may still litigate in a civil court. Throughout the process, the judiciary must respect (4)----: every defendant has the right to a fair hearing, however strong public anger may be.

exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘indict’ (resmen suçlamak): savcı büyük jüriden yetkiliyi resmen suçlamasını (indict) ister. ‘ostracize’ (dışlamak), ‘devalue’ (devalüe etmek), ‘liquidate’ (tasfiye etmek) ve ‘subsidize’ (sübvanse etmek) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘due process’ (hukuka uygun yargılama): iki nokta sonrası adil yargılanma hakkını açıklıyor; bu hukuka uygun yargılamadır. ‘plutocracy’ (plütokrasi), ‘urbanization’ (kentleşme), ‘globalization’ (küreselleşme) ve ‘nepotism’ (kayırmacılık) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.passage: Over the last forty years, globalization and rapid urbanization have brought great affluence to some cities, yet many citizens feel left behind. In former industrial towns, factory closures have produced high (1)----: people work part-time or in jobs far below their skills. Governments have responded in different ways. Some (2)---- local industries, devalue the currency or impose import quotas, policies that economists call protectionist; others prefer a more equitable redistribution of income through taxes. Both camps agree that groups which feel marginalized or disenfranchised by a distant, bureaucratic and hierarchical state may decide that the social contract has been broken and turn to ideological extremes or utopian promises. Populist leaders have used this anger to attack the judiciary and the press, weakening the (3)---- that a healthy democracy needs. Some analysts even warn of a slide towards oligarchy or plutocracy, in which wealthy donors and their lobbyists decide policy. Yet advocacy groups, a free press and an independent ombudsman can still hold power to account, and even powerful elites must respect the result of a (4)---- with a high turnout.
exercises.question: (1) numaralı boşluk için en uygun kelimeyi seçin.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘underemployment’ (eksik istihdam): iki nokta sonrası yarı zamanlı ya da niteliğin altında çalışmayı tanımlıyor; bu eksik istihdamdır. ‘abdication’ (tahttan feragat), ‘emancipation’ (özgürleşme), ‘inauguration’ (göreve başlama töreni) ve ‘jurisprudence’ (hukuk felsefesi) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘plebiscite’ (halk oylaması): katılım oranı (turnout) ve sonucuna uyulması gereken şey bir halk oylamasıdır. ‘despot’ (despot), ‘perpetrator’ (fail), ‘misdemeanour’ (hafif suç) ve ‘burglary’ (hırsızlık (eve/binaya girerek)) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.question: The ---- investigated complaints that bureaucrats had ignored requests for housing from underprivileged families.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘ombudsman’ (kamu denetçisi): kamu kurumlarına yönelik şikâyetleri inceleyen kişi kamu denetçisidir. ‘despot’ (despot), ‘litigant’ (davacı ya da davalı), ‘clergy’ (din adamları) ve ‘speculator’ (spekülatör) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.question: Historians still debate whether the ---- imposed on Germany after the First World War, which many Germans saw as a foreign edict, helped to cause the economic collapse of the 1920s.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘reparations’ (savaş tazminatları): savaş sonrası yenilen ülkeye ödetilen paralar savaş tazminatlarıdır. ‘plebiscites’ (halk oylamaları), ‘perpetrators’ (failler), ‘speculators’ (spekülatörler) ve ‘litigants’ (dava tarafları) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: Campaigners who won the abolition of the old asylums now fight the ___ attached to mental illness, since newspaper stories that stigmatize patients make many people avoid treatment.
exercises.translation: Eski akıl hastanelerinin kaldırılmasını sağlayan kampanyacılar şimdi ruhsal hastalığa yapıştırılan damgayla mücadele ediyor, çünkü hastaları damgalayan gazete haberleri birçok kişinin tedaviden kaçınmasına yol açıyor.

nodes.title: Ünite testi
nodes.description: 15 soruluk ünite testi; geçmek için %80 doğru yap

exercises.question: The scandal, which tarnished the reputation of the ministry and led to accusations of nepotism, began when a whistleblower revealed collusion between officials and contractors who used fraudulent invoices to ---- public funds.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘embezzle’ (zimmetine para geçirmek): yüklenicilerle işbirliği yapıp kamu fonlarını gizlice almak zimmete para geçirmektir. ‘adjudicate’ (hüküm vermek), ‘disenfranchise’ (oy hakkından yoksun bırakmak), ‘ostracize’ (dışlamak) ve ‘nationalize’ (devletleştirmek) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.question: Human rights lawyers, arguing that the law contravenes the constitution, described it as a flagrant ---- of the right to free expression and will challenge it in a court whose jurisprudence on free speech is strong.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘infringement’ (ihlal): ifade özgürlüğünü kısıtlayan bir yasa bu hakkın ihlalidir; ‘flagrant infringement’ açık ihlal demektir. ‘inauguration’ (göreve başlama töreni), ‘redistribution’ (yeniden dağıtım), ‘empowerment’ (güçlendirme) ve ‘urbanization’ (kentleşme) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.question: Many economists argue that the decision to ---- the currency may boost exports but will also push up the cost of imported food, hitting destitute families hardest.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘devalue’ (devalüe etmek): ihracatı artırıp ithal gıdayı pahalılaştıran karar para birimini devalüe etmektir. ‘litigate’ (dava açmak), ‘acquit’ (beraat ettirmek), ‘incarcerate’ (hapsetmek) ve ‘abolish’ (kaldırmak) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.question: Despite the crackdown, the ---- of drugs and weapons across the border has continued unabated, as the border region slides into anarchy and some customs officers accept bribes to let gangs smuggle goods.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘trafficking’ (kaçakçılık): sınırdan uyuşturucu ve silah geçirmek kaçakçılıktır (trafficking). ‘mediation’ (arabuluculuk), ‘suffrage’ (oy hakkı), ‘arbitration’ (tahkim) ve ‘abdication’ (tahttan feragat) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.question: Small firms rarely ---- against multinational companies and usually prefer arbitration, since legal costs for a small litigant can be enormous even when they are likely to win.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘litigate’ (dava açmak): yüksek hukuk masrafları dava açmayı (litigate) caydırır, bu yüzden küçük firmalar tahkimi tercih eder. ‘smuggle’ (kaçırmak (kaçakçılık yapmak)), ‘privatize’ (özelleştirmek), ‘liquidate’ (tasfiye etmek) ve ‘monopolize’ (tekeline almak) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.question: The inquiry into the forgery of safety certificates did not establish the ---- of individual managers, but it concluded that the company as a whole had been negligent.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘culpability’ (kusurluluk): soruşturma tek tek yöneticilerin kusurluluğunu belirleyemedi ama şirketi ihmalkâr buldu. ‘affluence’ (refah), ‘pluralism’ (çoğulculuk), ‘emancipation’ (özgürleşme) ve ‘abdication’ (tahttan feragat) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.question: After a cyberattack and an extortion attempt by hackers exposed the personal data of millions of customers, the ---- fined the bank and ordered it to improve its security.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘regulator’ (düzenleyici kurum): bankaya para cezası veren ve güvenliği iyileştirmesini emreden kurum düzenleyici kurumdur. ‘despot’ (despot), ‘perpetrator’ (fail), ‘philanthropist’ (hayırsever) ve ‘solicitor’ (avukat (İngiltere’de) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.question: In a ---- held in 1955, shortly after the king’s abdication, voters in the region chose by a large majority to remain part of the country.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘plebiscite’ (halk oylaması): seçmenlerin tek bir soruyu oyladığı yöntem halk oylamasıdır. ‘theocracy’ (teokrasi), ‘burglary’ (hırsızlık (eve/binaya girerek)), ‘misdemeanour’ (hafif suç) ve ‘quota’ (kota) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.question: Growing ---- has made the once egalitarian capital more divided: house prices have soared, and speculators now buy flats simply to sell them on a year later.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘affluence’ (refah): konut fiyatlarını yükselten şey başkentte artan refahtır. ‘anarchy’ (kargaşa), ‘perjury’ (yalan yere yemin), ‘stigma’ (damga) ve ‘abolition’ (kaldırılma) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.question: Lawyers will scrutinize every document before the court decides whether to ---- the dispute itself or send it back to an arbitrator.
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘adjudicate’ (hüküm vermek): mahkemenin anlaşmazlığı kendisi karara bağlaması (adjudicate) hakeme göndermenin alternatifidir. ‘ostracize’ (dışlamak), ‘devalue’ (devalüe etmek), ‘smuggle’ (kaçırmak (kaçakçılık yapmak)) ve ‘embezzle’ (zimmetine para geçirmek) bu bağlama uymaz.

exercises.question: Although the jury, which believed that a key witness had committed perjury, voted to acquit the defendant of murder, ----.
options: the evidence against him was therefore extremely weak
because the prosecutor had presented no witnesses
he was convicted of manslaughter and sentenced to four years’ imprisonment
so that he could be released on parole
whose lawyer had been a famous solicitor
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘he was convicted of manslaughter and sentenced to four years’ imprisonment’: ‘although’ cinayetten aklanmaya karşıt bir sonuç ister; taksirle öldürmeden mahkûmiyet bunu sağlar. ‘therefore extremely weak’ beraati destekler, karşıtlık kurmaz; ‘because the prosecutor…’ ana cümle değildir; ‘released on parole’ amaç bildirir ve mantıksızdır; ‘famous solicitor’ ise bağlanamayan bir yan cümledir.

exercises.question: ----, the new government promised at its inauguration to protect civil liberties, provide humanitarian aid and restore the independence of the judiciary.
options: Because it wanted to imprison all its opponents
Unless the clergy is given full political power
Even though the courts had always been independent
Having come to power after decades in which a despot ruled by decree
So as to monopolize the media and silence critics
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘Having come to power after decades in which a despot ruled by decree’: zorba bir yönetimin ardından özgürlükleri korumak ve yargıyı yeniden bağımsız kılmak mantıklıdır. ‘imprison all its opponents’ ve ‘silence critics’ vaatle çelişir; ‘Unless the clergy…’ şimdiki zamanla geçmiş vaadi bağlayamaz; ‘always been independent’ ise ‘restore’ fiiliyle çelişir.

exercises.question: Microloans, often funded by a wealthy philanthropist, can contribute to the empowerment of women in poor regions ----.
options: as long as they are combined with training, access to markets and efforts to reduce the stigma attached to working women
although they give women more control over their income
unless women gain more economic independence
which is why they cause widespread underemployment
so that men can monopolize the family’s savings
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘as long as they are combined with training, access to markets and efforts to reduce the stigma attached to working women’: güçlendirmenin koşulunu belirtir. ‘although they give women more control’ güçlendirmeyi destekler, karşıtlık kuramaz; ‘unless women gain…’ ana fikirle çelişir; ‘widespread underemployment’ ve ‘monopolize the family’s savings’ güçlendirmeyle uyuşmaz.

exercises.passage: In many countries prisons are overcrowded, and critics argue that it is costly and often pointless to incarcerate people who have committed a misdemeanour or a minor transgression; long detention before trial is even harder to justify. Probation, community work, early release on parole and restitution to victims are cheaper and may be more effective, and some reformers would abolish short sentences altogether. Supporters of restorative justice go further: they bring perpetrators and victims together, with a trained mediator present, so that offenders understand the harm they have caused. A victim of burglary, for example, can explain how it felt to lose the sense of safety at home. Studies suggest that this kind of mediation reduces reoffending, especially among young offenders who would otherwise be ostracized by their communities, although it is not suitable for every felony, and some victims prefer not to take part.
exercises.question: According to the passage, restorative justice ----.
options: is suitable for every kind of serious crime
requires all victims to take part in meetings
has been shown to increase reoffending
replaces probation and community work entirely
brings offenders face to face with the people they have harmed
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘brings offenders face to face with the people they have harmed’: metin failler ile mağdurların bir arabulucu eşliğinde bir araya getirildiğini söylüyor. ‘suitable for every kind’ metinle çelişir (her ağır suça uygun değil); ‘requires all victims’ da çelişir, çünkü bazı mağdurlar katılmıyor; ‘increase reoffending’ tersini söyler; ‘replaces probation’ metinde yoktur.

exercises.passage: In the 1980s and 1990s, many governments decided to privatize state-owned companies, from airlines to water suppliers. Supporters argued that private owners would run them more efficiently and invest more, while critics feared that a few firms would monopolize essential services. After the fall of communism, when socialism lost much of its appeal, privatization spread to Eastern Europe as well, where some firms were sold cheaply and others had to liquidate. The results have been mixed. Telephone services generally improved, but in several countries water and rail companies raised prices sharply while investing little, and some governments later chose to nationalize them again. Economists now tend to agree that what matters most is not ownership itself but effective regulation.
exercises.question: The author’s main conclusion is that ----.
options: strong regulation matters more than whether a company is public or private
privatization always leads to lower prices
all privatized companies should be nationalized again
telephone services became worse after privatization
private owners never invest in essential services
exercises.explanation: Doğru cevap ‘strong regulation matters more than whether a company is public or private’: son cümle önemli olanın mülkiyet değil etkili denetim olduğunu söylüyor. ‘always leads to lower prices’ metinle çelişir, çünkü bazı şirketler fiyat artırdı; ‘nationalized again’ yalnızca bazı hükümetlerin tercihidir; ‘became worse’ telefon hizmetlerinin iyileştiği bilgisiyle, ‘never invest’ ise ‘investing little’ ifadesiyle çelişir.
